name: PaletteFungalDeepwood
intent: A closed-in fungal deepwood of near-black rotting trunks and dark umber loam beneath pale old flagstones, lit only by a faint pale-violet cap-glow and wearing a muted spore violet accent on gills and shelf fungus.

critic_pass1.why: Dark loam with a pale flagstone road reads best of the run from every camera, the violet far rim and pale-violet light give it a place of its own, and it is properly dark and matte.
critic_pass1.fix: walk leafygrass 5 values darker and slightly more umber so the deepwood floor feels closed-in and the violet glow carries more

critic_pass2.why: A small umber shift in the loam changed little: the violet far land, mist and pale cap-light are distinctive, but walkable ground, rock and earth stay within a few values of each other, and from above the floor looks like E's.
